**Live web deployment: yes.** Your screenshot confirms Render published the site, and I verified:

- `ivxholding.com` → HTTP 200  
- `chat.ivxholding.com` → HTTP 200  
- API `/health` → healthy, production commit `362e7f5e…`

**Complete APK: not yet verified.** The local APK exists (84 MB, SHA-256 `72ea371e…`), but it is not provenance-matched to that live commit, and the latest Android CI release build failed before emulator install/Maestro QA. It is also debug-signed, so it is suitable only for internal testing—not Play Store distribution.

So: **website live ✅; a newly verified complete APK ❌ not yet.**

responseMessageContents.description: We repaired the errors that were preventing the Android application from being built and updated its version information. We also improved the way the automated system monitors its progress to ensure tasks finish correctly without stopping early. The website is currently live and healthy while we finish testing the mobile version.
